$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Agent Messages settings: how a message from another agent or a person (cmux agent message) reaches an agent in a terminal (issue 36496). The terminal agent hook helper reads these keys from the settings file (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-tui/src/bin/cmux-tui-hook/inbox.rs) and checks this file's defaults in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentMessages
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Agent Messages (issue 36496). Messages always reach an agent in its turns (the prompt hook); this decides whether an idle one is woken for them.

rows.name: claudeWake
rows.note: On: Claude Code in a cmux terminal, started through cmux's claude wrapper, runs a background asyncRewake hook after its start and each turn that waits in the daemon (agent.message.wait) and wakes an idle session with its messages as a system reminder. Off: the hook exits at once; messages wait for the session's next prompt. Read when the hook starts and again before it hands messages over.

help.text: When another agent or a person sends a message to Claude Code in a terminal, an idle session starts a turn to read it. Nothing is typed into the terminal. Off: the message waits for the next prompt in that session.
